meta.name: histolab
meta.description: Lightweight WSI tile extraction and preprocessing. Use for basic slide processing, tissue detection, tile extraction, and stain normalization for H&E images. Best for simple pipelines, dataset preparation, and quick tile-based analysis. For advanced spatial proteomics, multiplexed imaging, or deep learning pipelines use pathml.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从病理切片中提取组织区域并预处理图像
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在全切片图像上做组织检测和 tile 提取
copy.tagline_en: Extract tissue regions and preprocess whole slide images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need tissue detection and tile extraction from whole slide images

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你处理病理全切片图像：自动识别组织区域、提取小图块、标准化染色颜色，并准备用于深度学习的数据集。
howto.when: 当你需要从全切片图像（如 SVS、TIFF 格式）中提取组织图块，或进行染色标准化时触发。

say.text: 帮我从这张 SVS 切片中随机提取 100 张 512x512 的图块。
用网格方式提取这张切片的所有组织图块，重叠 0 像素。
say.note: Claude 会使用 GridTiler 进行全覆盖提取。

say.text: 对这张切片做 Macenko 染色标准化，参考这张目标图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can process whole slide images: automatically detect tissue regions, extract informative tiles, normalize staining, and prepare datasets for deep learning pipelines.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to extract tissue tiles from whole slide images (e.g., SVS, TIFF) or perform stain normalization.

say_en.text: Extract 100 random 512x512 tiles from this SVS slide.
say_en.note: Claude will use RandomTiler to extract and save tiles.

say_en.text: Extract all tissue tiles from this slide using a grid with no overlap.
say_en.note: Claude will use GridTiler for full coverage extraction.

say_en.text: Apply Macenko stain normalization to this slide using the target image.
say_en.note: Claude will use MacenkoStainNormalizer for stain normalization.
